hypothesis: ACE-style meta-amortization over a very broad prior family may teach a genuine prior-conditioned Bayes operator. The decisive extrapolation test remains the Uniform prior with zero support near theta_true: a Bayesian updater must keep posterior mass inside the supplied support.

prior_meta_distribution.source: ACE Appendix B.1, adapted from histogram priors to particle clouds

truth_modes.member: theta* is sampled directly from Theta_in; target is empirical-cloud Bayes.
truth_modes.distribution: theta* is an independent draw from the same underlying prior law as Theta_in.

evaluation_cases.name: gaussian_broad
evaluation_cases.note: Simple reference prior; most mass lies inside the ACE training domain.

evaluation_cases.name: gaussian_shifted_narrow
evaluation_cases.note: Strong prior-likelihood conflict, but Gaussian support remains nonzero everywhere.

evaluation_cases.name: uniform_broad
evaluation_cases.note: Exactly the flat-prior branch of the ACE training meta-distribution.

evaluation_cases.name: uniform_zero_support
evaluation_cases.note: Hard-support OOD stress test: exact posterior has ZERO mass near theta_true.

evaluation_cases.name: ace_bimodal
evaluation_cases.note: Explicit multimodality from the meta-training prior family.
